verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes building custom automations and rules that move work forward and keep Jira up to date across connected tools, so the core automation capability is first-party. The evidence is only feature-page claims, and none of it describes the trigger/condition/action rule structure an engineer would configure. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trigger-and-action rule building (trigger types, conditions, actions), in-depth first-party automation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps
